text:
Maria H: Heads-up — we're seeing doubled attribution in console for some tenant requests after the route-metadata shim landed this morning.
Kevin L: ugh, details? doubled how — two different route tags or duplicate tokens?
Maria H: Two different route tags. One from the SDK (new compact header) and one inserted by the internal proxy shim.
Samir: That makes sense, the proxy shim was supposed to be a fallback for older clients but it doesn't check for the compact header yet.
Anya P: Can we just dedupe during ingestion in the telemetry pipeline? quick fix probably easier than reverting.
Kevin L: We could, but deduping by header value is brittle — the two tags are semantically different (route_hint vs route_override) and downstream billing logic relies on precedence order.
Maria H: Right — billing currently prefers explicit SDK route_hint, but console aggregation is showing both which skews percent-of-traffic charts and quota attribution.
Samir: Proposed options: 1) update proxy shim to prefer existing headers and skip injecting when compact header present, 2) change SDK to stop sending legacy header until shim removed, 3) pipeline dedupe with precedence rules + flag.
Anya P: My vote is (1) + short-term (3) as mitigation. Changing the SDK is a bigger release and will break older clients unexpectedly.
Kevin L: Agree on (1)+(3). But (1) needs careful rollout across proxy fleet — we have ~30k egress proxies. Can we gate via feature flag per-customer?
Samir: Yes, proxy code already checks feature flags. We can add "avoid-inject-route-shim" flag and default ON for accounts showing compact header traffic.
Lina-bot: deploy-bot: new canary deployed to us-west/zone-a (proxy-shim v2.3.1)
Maria H: Nice. For (3) we need an ingestion rule: if both headers present, pick SDK compact header when present, else proxy shim. Also annotate event with which path was used for auditing.
Kevin L: Annotating is important so finance can reconcile. Make it a boolean field route_source in the events.
Anya P: Be careful — event schema change needs coordination with the console dashboard parsers. I'll open a PR to console-metrics to tolerate new field.
Samir: I'll do the proxy flag patch. Timeline: canary today, wider rollout tomorrow if no regressions.
Maria H: Also we should add an SDK compatibility note in devex — explain the compact header semantics and that proxy shim is transitional.
Kevin L: Samir, add a telemetry test case that simulates SDK + shim both present and verifies precedence.
Samir: Will do. Also planning a tiny migration dashboard tile: show % of requests carrying only legacy shim vs compact header vs both. Helps decide when to flip defaults.
Anya P: UX: keep the rollout toggle in console under Routing -> Global -> Shim compatibility. Product wants a warning banner for tenants when their traffic is mixed.
Maria H: Good idea. Product: @Anya can you draft the banner text? Something like "We detected mixed routing metadata — your console metrics may show duplicated routes until migration completes."
Anya P: Drafted in PR #4102. Short + actionable with link to migration guide.
Kevin L: One more thing — quota enforcement currently runs in the edge proxy. If we skip injecting shim header, older clients might suddenly be charged under a different quota bucket if SDK header wasn't present. We need a grace window where proxy maps legacy to the canonical route for enforcement.
Samir: Right — enforcement mapping will be kept for 7 days by default; we'll add a mapping table that maps legacy header to canonical route when dedupe flag on.
Maria H: OK put that in rollout plan. Owner list: Samir (proxy), Anya (console + UX), Kevin (billing/metrics), Maria (coord + monitoring).
Lina-bot: alert-bot: anomaly detected: route-discrepancy spike +12% since 09:12 UTC
Maria H: We saw that. Canary will help. Getting monitoring graphs to show pre/post canary by tenant is next action.
Anya P: I'll add a console tile for canary cohort.
Kevin L: After stabilization, we should schedule an SDK deprecation for legacy header in 6 weeks and announce to customers. Devex note + release notes.
Samir: Agreed. I'll open the proxy PR today (w/ feature flag), telemetry mitigation PR, and a short test plan.
Maria H: Thanks team. Quick checklist in thread: 1) proxy flag patch -> canary (Samir) 2) ingestion precedence rule + route_source annotation (Kevin) 3) console parser tolerance + canary tile + banner (Anya) 4) monitoring + rollback runbook (Maria) 5) communication plan + SDK deprecation timeline (Devex + Product)
Kevin L: I'll own (2) and work with infra to add route_source to the event contract.
Anya P: Noted. I'll coordinate with product for banner wording and customer comms.
Samir: PRs: proxy#847, telemetry#391, testplan.md linked in the PR description.
Maria H: Great. If we catch no regressions in 6 hours we'll start region-by-region rollout.
Lina-bot: deploy-bot: wider canary scheduled for 1777775000
Kevin L: Thanks all. Filing a follow-up convo in #product-routemeta for the deprecation calendar. :thumbsup:
Maria H: Closing thread for now — will update with PR links and rollback steps.
